gate1.verdict: OPEN: naturally co-existing cell types respond in substantially different directions.

premise.verdict: PREMISE HOLDS: mean similarity does not determine compartment-specific similarity, so the mean is lossy in real tumour tissue.

gate2.verdict: OPEN: natural tumour compartments are far more separable than our constructed mixture (ceiling 0.964 versus 0.692). Gate 2 is NOT a universal information limit; it was a limit of the constructed benchmark. In real tissue the structure is there and unsupervised clustering finds it.
